title: Starter journey visual refresh — hero, step diagram, and in-product screenshots
creator: Asha Patel
description: Refresh the 'getting started' landing experience for new users (branding: Starter Journey) with three deliverables: 1) a high-impact hero illustration that communicates low-friction onboarding and production-ready inference, 2) a horizontal step diagram that replaces the current vertical list and clarifies the four quick actions (Sign up, Create API key, Try a sample request, Explore models), and 3) updated in-product screenshots for the Quickstart card and API keys modal across desktop/tablet/mobile. Deliverables should be accessible (WCAG AA contrast), follow Redwood visual language, and be ready for an A/B test with a conservative variant that only changes hero art. Primary success metrics: +10% CTA clickthrough on onboarding flow, +8% completion rate of 'create API key' step within 7 days. Include Figma source, export sheets for engineering, and final assets for release notes and marketing.
